mapper.insert: insert into log_runtime_record (event_id, trace_id, request_id, level, logger_name, thread_name, biz_module, source_app, host_name, environment, message, message_digest, exception_class, stack_trace, occurred_at, created_at) values (#{eventId}, #{traceId}, #{requestId}, #{level}, #{loggerName}, #{threadName}, #{bizModule}, #{sourceApp}, #{hostName}, #{environment}, #{message}, #{messageDigest}, #{exceptionClass}, #{stackTrace}, #{occurredAt}, now(3))
mapper.select: select id, event_id as eventId, trace_id as traceId, request_id as requestId, level, logger_name as loggerName, thread_name as threadName, biz_module as bizModule, source_app as sourceApp, host_name as hostName, environment, message, message_digest as messageDigest, exception_class as exceptionClass, stack_trace as stackTrace, occurred_at as occurredAt from log_runtime_record where event_id > #{eventId} order by event_id asc limit #{limit}
